verification.summary: All requested advisory checks passed before commit dd57f0d was pushed. The NL pilot returned ADVISORY_PASS despite the profile mentioning operator-relayed skill chains that may fix CI failures, because the same-paragraph limitations and non-authority wording kept the profile advisory and evidence-bounded.

notes: No evidence-band, reviewer-decision, index, status-doc, validator, dependency, or fixture changes.
Operator-relayed video evidence was labeled in metadata, capability rows, limitations, and rationale.
Scope stayed inside the named harness profile.
No promotion, required gate, routing, runtime authority, default-mode, live execution, or V2-removal scope was added.

friction_notes: The shadow record was backfilled after commit dd57f0d rather than authored before the profile update.
The profile update relied on operator-relayed video details; the profile preserved that provenance split instead of treating the video as independently observed evidence.
false_positive_notes: No advisory false positives observed. The NL pilot did not flag the autonomous-adjacent CI wording after it was bounded by same-paragraph limitations.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed in the final advisory checks.

phase2_design_signals: Bounded evidence-profile updates should include a shadow mission record in the same change cycle unless explicitly waived.
Same-paragraph provenance and non-authority limitations can allow potentially risky external-source observations to remain useful without implying local capability evidence.
Future Claude Code local evidence still requires a separately approved read-only probe; this profile update does not move the evidence band off insufficient_evidence.
